SELECT t_sku_file.id, t_sku_file.`status`, t_sku_file.sku_no AS skuNo, t_sku_file.sku_name AS skuName, t_sku_file.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_sku_file.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_sku_file.main_or_byproduct AS mainOrByproduct, t_sku_file.executive_standard AS executiveStandard, t_sku_file.standard_number AS standardNumber, t_sku_file.org_no AS orgNo, t_sku_file.org_name AS orgName, t_sku_file.dept_no AS deptNo, t_sku_file.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_sku_file WHERE t_sku_file.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_sku_file.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.id}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.sku_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuNo}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.skuName}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.product_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassNo}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.product_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.productClassName}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.main_or_byproduct LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.mainOrByproduct}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.executive_standard LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.executiveStandard}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.standard_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.standardNumber}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.dept_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptNo}, '%')
AND t_sku_file.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_sku_file.gmt_modified DESC
